text: Excellent service, quality products, and noticeable results.

I received acne treatment here. Initially, I was worried it would be like other clinics where I've had multiple treatments without success, as I have PCOS, a hormonal imbalance that causes recurring acne around my jawline and chin. During my initial consultation, the doctor was excellent, explaining PCOS in detail. She didn't try to push expensive treatments, but instead chose a course suitable for me. After about two months of treatment, the results are amazing! ☺️ My face, which used to be covered in hormonal acne around my jawline and under my chin, is now completely clear. Plus, I haven't even finished my current treatment course yet, and I can save the remaining sessions for later. I'm so impressed! The clinic staff are also very attentive, calling to remind me of my appointments and following up after each treatment. If you're interested in acne treatment and other cosmetic procedures, I highly recommend Dr. Han's clinic. You won't be disappointed! 💚
